name: third-party.playwright-mcp
description: Curated provider manifest for the browser.verify capability.

browser.verify.fallback: Manual browser verification with screenshots, accessibility notes and reproduction steps.

install.method: Configure the upstream Playwright MCP server for the target agent.
uninstall: Remove the Playwright MCP server from the target agent MCP configuration and remove this provider plugin from the AgentRig install set.

filesystem: Browser profile/cache locations selected by the upstream server
permissions.approval: Human approval required for mutating flows touching real accounts, data or payments.

transport.notes: Local MCP server exposing browser automation tools.

security.notes: Default to read/verify flows. Sensitive or destructive browser actions require explicit user confirmation.

risk.notes: Browser automation can mutate real accounts or data when pointed at live systems.
